trainer.name: livekit-wakeword
trainer.note: Same commit and frontends as xiaoya.onnx. Steps after augmentation were run by draduck_wakeword/train_steps.py, because run_extraction needs SessionOptions at this commit.

data.positives: the nee positives plus MiniMax speech-2.8-turbo voices: 15 Japanese, 32 Mandarin (the Japanese phrase with language boost Japanese and auto, and four Chinese-character spellings of how a Mandarin speaker says it; the list is in the generator), 12 English, 10 Korean; 3614 train / 738 test, test voices held out
data.negatives: the nee negatives plus MiniMax near misses and everyday Japanese and Mandarin sentences in the same voices; 10872 train / 1935 test

evaluation.held_out_voices_2026_11_24: at 0.35 (clean): Mandarin 92% (nee 49%), English 86% (nee 61%), Japanese 100% (96%), Korean 96% (100%); old test positives 100%
evaluation.stream_test_2026_11_24: ねえ、ドラダック 29/30, ドラダック alone 2-4/30, 0 false wakes in 7.6 min family talk, 1 in 3.8 min packed near misses at 0.3-0.5
evaluation.known_problem: wakes on 「ねえ、ドラマ見た？」「ねえ、トラック来たよ」「ねえ、ママ」 in some voices: 14% of the held-out Japanese near-miss clips at 0.35, 4.5% of the Mandarin ones (nee 0%); livekit false wakes per hour 0.93 at 0.5 against 0.05 for nee (different validation sets); nee4 adds such negatives
